variable_coverage.construction: AdjROA_{t+1}: Industry-adjusted ROA at t+1: firm-specific ROA minus the median ROA in the same year and two-digit SIC industry; ROA is income before extraordinary items divided by lagged total assets. Formula: ROA_{t+1} − median(ROA_{same year, two-digit SIC}). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

BEAT_t: Indicator equal to 1 when net income divided by total assets is at least 0.01, or the change in net income divided by total assets from t−1 to t is at least 0.01, and BENCH is not 1; 0 otherwise. The earnings variables are scaled by beginning-of-year assets. Formula: 1{NI-scaled_t≥0.01 or ΔNI-scaled_t≥0.01, and BENCH_t≠1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

JUSTMISS_t: Indicator equal to 1 when net income or its change from t−1 to t, each scaled by total assets, is at least −0.01 but below zero, and neither BENCH nor BEAT is 1; 0 otherwise. The earnings variables are scaled by beginning-of-year assets. Formula: 1{NI-scaled_t∈[−0.01,0) or ΔNI-scaled_t∈[−0.01,0), and BENCH_t≠1, BEAT_t≠1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

BENCH_t: Indicator equal to 1 when either net income divided by total assets or the change in net income divided by total assets from t−1 to t is at least 0 and less than 0.01; 0 otherwise. The paper elsewhere describes the denominators as total assets at the beginning of the year. Formula: 1{NI-scaled_t∈[0,0.01) or ΔNI-scaled_t∈[0,0.01)}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

R&D RM_t: Indicator equal to 1 if the residual from the normal R&D expense model (Equation 1) is in the lowest quintile; 0 otherwise. Formula: 1{residual(Eq.1) in lowest quintile}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

BENCH_t × R&D RM_t: Product of BENCH_t and R&D RM_t; each component is the indicator defined in the paper, so the interaction equals one only when both indicators equal one. Formula: BENCH_t × R&D RM_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

AdjROA_t: Industry-adjusted ROA: firm-specific ROA minus median ROA in the same year and two-digit SIC industry; ROA is income before extraordinary items divided by lagged total assets. Formula: ROA_t − median(ROA_{same year, two-digit SIC}). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
SIZE_t: Natural logarithm of total assets. Formula: ln(total assets_t). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
MTB_t: Market value of equity divided by book value of equity. Formula: market value of equity_t / book value of equity_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

RETURN_t: Size-adjusted abnormal return: monthly buy-and-hold raw return minus the monthly buy-and-hold return on a size-matched decile portfolio, compounded over the 12 months of fiscal year t. Formula: compound_{12 months in fiscal year t}(monthly buy-and-hold raw return − monthly buy-and-hold size-decile portfolio return). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

ZSCORE_{t−1}: Modified Altman financial-health measure lagged one period in Equation (6): 3.3×net income/lagged assets + 1.0×sales/lagged assets + 1.4×retained earnings/lagged assets + 1.2×working capital/lagged assets. Formula: ZSCORE_{t−1}; ZSCORE_t=3.3(NI_t/A_{t−1})+1.0(Sales_t/A_{t−1})+1.4(RetainedEarnings_t/A_{t−1})+1.2(WorkingCapital_t/A_{t−1}). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
RD_t/A_{t−1}: R&D expense (COMPUSTAT Data46) divided by total assets at t−1. Formula: RD_t/A_{t−1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
1/A_{t−1}: Reciprocal of total assets at t−1, the scaled constant regressor printed in the model. Formula: 1/A_{t−1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
MV_t: Natural logarithm of market value, calculated from COMPUSTAT Data199 × Data25. Formula: ln(Data199_t × Data25_t). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

Q_t: Tobin’s Q, calculated using the COMPUSTAT items shown in the paper: ((Data199×Data25)+Data130+Data9+Data34)/Data6. The paper does not further define those data items in this description. Formula: ((Data199_t×Data25_t)+Data130_t+Data9_t+Data34_t)/Data6_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

INT_t/A_{t−1}: Internal funds (COMPUSTAT Data18 + Data46 + Data14) divided by total assets at t−1. Formula: (Data18_t+Data46_t+Data14_t)/Data6_{t−1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.
RD_{t−1}/A_{t−1}: Prior-year R&D expense (COMPUSTAT Data46) divided by total assets at t−1. Formula: RD_{t−1}/A_{t−1}. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

implementation_issues.description: The paper describes the baseline as cross-sectional regression but does not name the underlying estimator; the year-by-industry support fits likewise do not identify the within-cell estimator.
Equation (1) states 1988–2000, while the general estimation text states 1988–2002 for equations 1–4; the raw envelope conservatively uses the broader period.
The paper uses legacy numeric Compustat Data item codes; no exact item-code-to-current-column crosswalk is supplied, so candidate fields are not treated as verified mappings.
Aggregate RM is described using production model 3 in the appendix/table definition, while the production-cost support fit is Equation 4; the intended residual version is ambiguous.
